candidate_relations.reason: The Indian-file growth pattern, ER/GATA3/GCDFP15 positivity, associated mammary-type apocrine glands, prior pregnancy/lactation-related axillary swelling, and negative breast imaging support primary invasive lobular breast carcinoma in ectopic cutaneous breast tissue rather than primary cutaneous apocrine carcinoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Axillary apocrine gland carcinoma asserts a different primary lineage and omits the invasive lobular subtype arising in heterotopic cutaneous breast tissue.
